recommended_candidates.text:
Salam Jonas,

Please let me know what you think about this first round of customer feedback, which I have grouped by issue below.

Field behavior and text entry:
• Proposal (Indstilling) placeholder fields: Unlike in the Executive Summary, clicking the "insert" fields—Advantages, settings, attachments, headline, and date—does not automatically clear the existing text.
• Guidance (Vejledning) reflections: Under "(write own reflections, if any)," the placeholder text has the same failure to clear automatically as in the Proposal fields.
• Board Seminar (Bestyrelsesseminar) agenda: The "(insert agenda)" field has the same automatic-clearing issue as the Proposal fields.
• Proposal text boxes: When the boxes on the left, including the headline, run out of room, words do not wrap automatically. The right-hand column is pushed farther to the right instead.
• Proposal line breaks: Because automatic wrapping is missing, users are forced to insert line breaks manually. A normal line break (hard return) creates excessive spacing for continuous text, even though that spacing works well between bullet points. A soft return (Shift\+Enter) gives the correct result, but I doubt our colleagues know how to use it.
• Board Seminar multi-line support: Under "Item and Title," users must be able to enter multiple lines, including through manual line breaks.

Layout and formatting:
• Guidance margins: The margins beneath the "(short description)" section are not fixed. Without manual line breaks, the "pencil" icon is gradually cut off. Can fixed margins be set there?
• Guidance theme description: This has the same hard-return spacing problem as the Proposal.
• Board Meeting (Bestyrelsesmøde) alignment: Compared with "Topic," "Proposal," and "Start time," "Item and Title" is not aligned correctly.
• Board Meeting formatting: An extra horizontal line or border appears whenever I add a line immediately after a "Topic." Adding a line anywhere else works as intended.

Date functionality:
• Proposal: Could the date functionality used in the "Board Seminar" document also be implemented here?
• Board Meeting: Is it possible to use the date functionality from the "Board Seminar" document here as well?

Master:
• Review: Because the bullet sizes and spacing still look incorrect on my screen, we need to review them with Tariq.
• Tables: Please provide an explanation or walkthrough showing how the tables work.
• Color palette: The full set of currently available colors should not all be offered as options.
